title: Research Problems in Function Theory — Problem 4.19
exact_target: Does every sum of k cosine functions with distinct positive integer frequencies have integral absolute value bounded below by a fixed multiple of log k?

sources.citation: ULAM.AI and the UnsolvedMath Contributors, \emph{UnsolvedMath: A Curated Collection of Open Mathematics Problems}, record 2304019 (AMR-022-4019). CC BY 4.0.
Walter K. Hayman and Edward F. Lingham, \emph{Research Problems in Function Theory}, arXiv:1809.07200, 2018. Problem 4.19, its complete Update 4.19, and the relevant chapter notation.

Julian Sahasrabudhe, \emph{Counting Zeros of Cosine Polynomials: On a Problem of Littlewood}, arXiv:1610.07680v3, 2019. Introduction, p. 2; Section 3, Theorem 8 and its immediate cosine-polynomial consequence, p. 8.
